source_state: Uncommitted working tree; source hashes identify this integration on top of earlier goal work. Historical milestone records remain unchanged.

coverage.extended_regression: The actual admitted-source failure now attempts a larger successor and verifies unchanged accounting and no new native/controller work.

behavior: Unique funding owners explicitly delegate move-only weak pool/execution/account tokens. Tokens retain no numerical payload or account lifetime and Drop changes no policy.

Shared prefill candidate admission validates all proof and identity facts before atomically raising only authorized completed finite ceilings and reserving the successor. Legacy APIs pass no handoffs.

Every account being raised must have a closed run, certified scopes, no quarantine and zero remaining workspace. Unchanged accounts keep ordinary constraints; unrelated equal-valued limits and fixed pool capacity remain binding.
Physical registrations, origin funding ids, bytes and unquoted exclusion remain unchanged. Each predecessor keeps its adopted ceiling until final retirement, even if the successor retires first.
Native session custody remains outside model payload and escaped output owners; existing core predecessor fencing and text step authority are unchanged.

Rejected candidates preserve ceilings, used, peak and token eligibility. Successful admission commits policy even if later preparation fails; safely settled failures release unused workspace and genuine uncertified work retains existing protections.
verified_fixtures: Atomic exact/-1 admission with old physical storage; A-to-B-to-C, alias-only and zero-byte descendants; expired/foreign/duplicate token rejection; fixed/unrelated limits, overflow, poison, unquoted exclusion, concurrent admission/certification and reentrant key destruction.

Real neutral metadata equations exercise incomplete first candidate, larger over-budget candidate, fitting smaller candidate, all-rejected plans, foreign proofs/geometry, controller fixed-source credit and preservation of fatal mechanism errors.

Nonzero three-layer direct-disk Llama starts A at its exact finite cold capacity; ordinary and controlled B use twice that finite capacity with all old tokens, raw strided alias and completed SubmissionResources retained. B agrees with a fresh resident reference through cached decode.
A raw alias retains its physical identity/capacity, charge and adopted limit after B, the runtime and all request metadata retire. Final alias release retires the account and unquoted exclusion.
A minimum-chunk successor rejects one byte below its exact required capacity without reads, controller callbacks, input/sampler activity or policy changes, then succeeds at the exact boundary.

A real live prepared continuation refuses a larger capacity; a safely settled injected sampling-setup failure preserves adopted policy while releasing unused workspace; a genuine changed-source native failure refuses a larger subsequent admission.
limits: This is delegated completed-funding capacity succession for the existing managed token-ID path, not general snapshot/copy admission or a new execution authority.
Quarantined funding cannot be repriced and still needs independent certified cleanup. Historical low-level reservation APIs keep their original lifetime semantics.
No new released-checkpoint comparison, whole-model allocator/process peak or native distributed validation accompanies this change.

Grammar/compiler and semantic-host state, dynamic controls/capture, independent quoted reset/restore/fork/copy, complete media/speculative/distributed and remaining host/disk admission, quarantine cleanup and arbitrary raw-output/completion accounting remain unfinished. The full goal is incomplete.
